Piyush Goyal seeks WTO-compliant trade measures at G20 meet

Union Minister Piyush Goyal met with his counterparts from France, Canada, Saudi Arabia, and South Korea during the G20 Trade Ministers' meeting in the US. The discussions focused on enhancing bilateral trade relations and addressing global trade distortions through measures compliant with World Trade Organization (WTO) norms.
